parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json;const b=r.body??r;const c=String(r.__channel||'');const s=v=>v==null||v===''?null:String(v);let sender=null,id=null,text='',at=null;if(c==='whatsapp'){const v=b.entry?.[0]?.changes?.[0]?.value||b;const m=v.messages?.[0];if(v.statuses&&!m)return[{json:{route:'ignore',reason:'whatsapp_status'}}];sender=s(m?.from||b.sender_id||b.from);id=s(m?.id||b.message_id||b.id);text=m?.text?.body??b.text??b.message??'';at=s(m?.timestamp||b.occurred_at||b.timestamp);}else if(c==='instagram'){const m=b.entry?.[0]?.messaging?.[0];const x=m?.message;if(!x&&b.object)return[{json:{route:'ignore',reason:'instagram_non_message'}}];sender=s(m?.sender?.id||b.sender_id||b.from);id=s(x?.mid||b.message_id||b.id);text=x?.text??b.text??'';at=s(b.occurred_at||b.timestamp);}else if(c==='email'){sender=s(b.from?.email||b.sender?.email||b.from||b.sender||b.email);id=s(b.messageId||b.message_id||b.id);text=b.textPlain??b.text??b.body??'';at=s(b.occurred_at||b.timestamp);}else return[{json:{route:'reject',reason:'unsupported_channel'}}];return[{json:{route:'candidate',event_input:{channel:c,sender_id:sender,external_message_id:id,text:String(text).trim(),occurred_at:at,company_id:s(b.company_id),owner_id:s(b.owner_id)}}}];
